config_schema.changelog: Initial: client prompt string (cache key), question language, Ja/Nein answer tokens, top log-probabilities, one token at T=0, the head/tail text cut, the control-tag neutraliser, score_raw = logit, score_0_100 = 100 x p_yes, the failure share above which a run fails.

versions.name: Apertus 8B zero-shot Ja/Nein, the D-074 chain
versions.changelog: Initial (D-075, D-076): the scoring chain of the D-074 benchmark, byte for byte (prompt, 14,000-character cut, one token, top 20, Ja/Nein sets, P(Ja)/(P(Ja)+P(Nein))), judged by Apertus v1.5 8B, the model at least as good as the 70B on every primary metric where a difference is resolvable. Adds a control-tag neutraliser (G4) that is identity on texts without such tags.
